say:1:1220705001:1.text: Speak up, what are you looking for? Just tell me, and I can track it down.
say:1:1220705001:1.source_cn: 说吧，在找什么？只要你说出来，我都能帮你找到。

Look around, everyone here is focused on getting a drink except you.

say:6:1220705004:1.text: Gray Amber... Ah, it might be that I know something of it...
say:6:1220705004:1.source_cn: 灰琥珀啊……我倒是有点消息。
say:6:1220705004:1.male: Gray Amber... Ah, it might be that I know something of it...
say:6:1220705004:1.female: Gray Amber... Ah, it might be that I know something of it...

say:7:1220705005:1.text: However, *cough*, you are likely aware that Rustport has been unsettled recently, so my services don't come easily.
say:7:1220705005:1.source_cn: 不过，咳，老板们大概也知道，最近的锈锚港不太平，我这生...

choice_prompt:8:1220705005.text: However, *cough*, you are likely aware that Rustport has been unsettled recently, so my services don't come easily.
choice_prompt:8:1220705005.source_cn: 不过，咳，老板们大概也知道，最近的锈锚港不太平，我这生意可不好做啊。

say:9:1220705006:1.text: Ah, I thank you for your patronage. To be blunt, you won't find any Gray Amber in Rustport these days.
say:9:1220705006:1.source_cn: 噢，感谢惠顾。我就直说吧，最近在锈锚港都别想买到灰琥珀了。
say:9:1220705006:1.male: Ah, I thank you for your patronage. To be blunt, you won't find any Gray Amber in Rustport these days.
say:9:1220705006:1.female: Ah, I thank you for your patronage. To be blunt, you won't find any Gray Amber in Rustport these days.

say:11:1220705007:1.text: What? We can't buy any at all?

say:12:1220705008:1.text: Rustport is a powder keg of gang conflict right now—any spark could set it off. Whether it's through legitimate business or the underground market, who would dare handle such premium stock?
say:12:1220705008:1.source_cn: 现在的锈锚港可是帮派乱斗的火药桶，一点就炸。不管正经市...

say:13:1220705009:1.text: The gangs control all business in Rustport. With things as they are, even fishing boats don't dare to slip away in secret. After all, no profit is worth more than your life!
say:13:1220705009:1.source_cn: 黑帮控制着整个锈锚港的市场，目前这样子，捕捞船也不敢偷...

say:14:1220705010:1.text: But you just said you knew something!

say:15:1220705011:1.text: I did, and saying it's unavailable saves you from wasting valuable time in Rustport. That's a good deal if you ask me!
say:15:1220705011:1.source_cn: 当然，“买不到”也是一个情报，免得你们在锈锚港浪费时间...

say:16:1220705012:1.text: And with that, I declare our business concluded. Think I'll have a drink or five now. Come by any time, friends.
say:16:1220705012:1.source_cn: 收费内容到此结束，我要喝几杯了。欢迎下次惠顾，老板。
say:16:1220705012:1.male: And with that, I declare our business concluded. Think I'll have a drink or five now. Come by any time, friends.
say:16:1220705012:1.female: And with that, I declare our business concluded. Think I'll have a drink or five now. Come by any time, friends.
